# Setup

## Loading libraries. 

```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
theme_set(theme_classic())
library(ggpubr)
library(ggpointdensity)
library(viridis)
library(pROC)

```


```{r}

n_model = 20

setting_list = c()

feature_choices = c("alpha_cdr3", "beta_cdr3", 
                    "alpha_cdr3_v", "beta_cdr3_v", 
                    "both_cdr3",  "both_cdr3_v")

enc_methods = c("one_hot", "blosum62", "atchley", "pca")

n_CNNs = c("1", "2")

n_units = c("32_16", "64_32", "128_64", "256_128")

```

# Load test data 
```{r}
df_test_pos = read.csv("data_for_model/test_pos.csv", header=TRUE)
df_test_neg = read.csv("data_for_model/test_neg.csv", header=TRUE)
dim(df_test_pos)
dim(df_test_neg)

test_labels = c(rep(1, nrow(df_test_pos)), rep(0, nrow(df_test_neg)))
```

# Take average of scores and compute AUC

```{r}

df_seeds = read.table("ensemble_seeds_20.txt", sep = "\t", header=FALSE)
dim(df_seeds)
head(df_seeds)

feature_col = c()
encoding_col = c()
n_CNN_col = c()
n_units_col = c()
auc_col = c()

for (feature in feature_choices){
  for (enc in enc_methods){
    for (n_CNN in n_CNNs){
      for (n_unit in n_units){
      
        cur_folder = paste0(feature, "_", enc, "_", n_CNN, "_CNN_dense2_n_units_", n_unit)
        
        # print(cur_folder)
        
        score_dir = paste0("results/sc_TCR_scores_cutoff_10000/", cur_folder)
        
        all_files = list.files(score_dir)
        
        test_list = list()
        
        for (i in 1:length(all_files)){
          
          cur_filename = all_files[i]
          df_test = read.csv(paste0(score_dir, "/", cur_filename), 
                             header=TRUE)    
          test_list[[i]] = df_test$score
          
        }
      
        # print(length(test_list))
        stopifnot(length(test_list)==n_model)
    
        test_mat = matrix(unlist(test_list), ncol=n_model, byrow=FALSE)
      
        # print(dim(test_mat))
        
        stopifnot(all(test_mat[1:5, 11] == test_list[[11]][1:5]))
        
        ave_test = rowSums(test_mat)/n_model
        
        df_ave_test = data.frame(score = ave_test)   
        
        dir.create(file.path("results/sc_TCR_ensemble_scores_cutoff_10000", 
                             cur_folder))
        
        write.csv(df_ave_test, 
                  paste0("results/sc_TCR_ensemble_scores_cutoff_10000/", 
                         cur_folder, 
                         "/ensemble_scores.csv"), 
                  row.names=FALSE)    
        
          
      # print(paste0(cur_folder, " test AUC:"))
      cur_auc = auc(test_labels, ave_test, direction = "<")
      # print(cur_auc)
      # print("                                          ")
      # print("------------------------------------------")
      
      feature_col = c(feature_col, feature)
      encoding_col = c(encoding_col, enc)
      n_units_col = c(n_units_col, n_unit)
      n_CNN_col = c(n_CNN_col, n_CNN)
      auc_col = c(auc_col, cur_auc)
    }
   }
  }
}

df_auc = data.frame(feature=feature_col, 
                    encoding=encoding_col,
                    n_units=n_units_col,
                    n_CNN=n_CNN_col, 
                    auc=auc_col)

write.csv(df_auc, 
          file="results/ensemble_auc.csv", 
          row.names=FALSE)

```
